args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I like its clean, minimalist design — it's refreshing to see a personal site that isn't cluttered. One suggestion: consider adding a bit more content, such as an "About Me" section, your interests or hobbies, and maybe some projects you're working on. That would give visitors a better sense of who you are. Also, displaying your email is helpful for contact, but you might want to add a contact form or links to social profiles as well. Overall, a nice simple start — keep building on it!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's great to see a personal blog, and I love that you mention your favorite hobby is hiking — that's a wonderful theme to build content around!
